{{Quote|War does not come with a guarantee. No soldier gets the promise of safety, survival or victory. But men, I guarantee you this: every member of this clone youth brigade will have his moment. And it is that moment when you are no longer a cadet. You are a soldier.|Crasher to the [[Cloning|clone]] cadets abroad the ''[[Endurance]]''|<ref name="Death Trap" />}}
'''Crasher''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who oversaw the [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] of the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] infiltrated the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] in order to get close to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] so he could get his revenge. The group which he infiltrated was overseen by Crasher. When Boba sabotaged the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']], [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Kilian]] ordered Crasher and the cadets flee the doomed vessel in escape pods. He later informed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] that one of the cadets' pods had been unaccounted for and so Skywalker and Windu searched for it and finally found it, with the cadets all safe and alive.
